method: Codex computer-use browser walkthrough against an isolated standalone library

checks.observed: Paste alone started acquisition. Dummy PDF file appeared with a managed author-undated-title-id filename, review notice, one-page image and selectable text.
Selected generated example-1.pdf and example-2.pdf together. Both saved automatically in sequence; library then contained three records. Saved filenames were visible in the queue.
Opened A guide to spatial representations from its queue result. Reader showed page1 of3 and selectable synthetic text.
A URL with a nonstandard port was rejected. Library still contained three papers; failed URL remained in input and a Retry control appeared.
Browser error/warning log query returned an empty list.

limits: No OS-level drag gesture automated; actual application drop handlers have separate synthetic-event tests.
Public network test used a synthetic W3C PDF; no real research library or live provider generation.
No formal user study or total-memory measurement.
